condition.narrative: As per PIA Section 3.5 (a) (ii), MCA-Mongolia must deliver to MCC, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, any proposed waiver or deferral (together with a justification) of any condition to such Disbursement.

As per PIA Section 3.5 (a) (iv), MCA-Mongolia must deliver to MCC, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, a certificate of MCA-Mongolia, dated as of the date of such Disbursement Request, substantially in the form of the "MCA Disbursement Certificate" posted on the MCC Website (the "MCA Disbursement Certificate").

As per PIA Section 3.5 (b) (ii), MCA-Mongolia must satisfy, as MCC determines in its sole discretion, the condition that, no material default or breach of any covenant, obligation or responsibility by the Government, MCA-Mongolia or any Government entity has occurred and is continuing under this Agreement, the Compact or any Supplemental Agreement.

As per PIA Section 3.5 (b) (iii), MCA-Mongolia must satisfy, as MCC determines in its sole discretion, the condition that, activities to be funded with MCC Funding being requested by such Disbursement Request will not violate any applicable law or regulation.

As per PIA Section 3.5 (b) (iv), MCA-Mongolia must satisfy, as MCC determines in its sole discretion, the condition that, the Implementation Plan Documents submitted to MCC are current and updated and are in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, and there has been satisfactory progress on the components of the Implementation Plan for any relevant Project or Project activities related to such Disbursement.

As per PIA Section 3.5 (b) (ix), MCA-Mongolia must satisfy, as MCC determines in its sole discretion, the condition that, MCC does not have grounds for concluding that any matter certified to it in the related MCA Disbursement Certificate, the Procurement Agent Disbursement Certificate or the Fiscal Agent Disbursement Certificate is not as certified.

As per PIA Section 3.5 (b) (viii), MCA-Mongolia must satisfy, as MCC determines in its sole discretion, the condition that, the Government has satisfied all of its payment obligations, including any insurance, indemnification, tax payments or other obligations, and contributed all resources required from it, under the Compact, this Agreement and any Supplemental Agreement.

As per PIA Section 3.5 (b) (x), MCA-Mongolia must satisfy, as MCC determines in its sole discretion, the condition that, MCC has not determined, in its sole discretion, that an act, omission, condition, or event has occurred that would be the basis for MCC to suspend or terminate, in whole or in part, MCC Funding in accordance with Section 5.1 of the Compact.

As per PIA Section 3.5 (b) (xi), MCA-Mongolia must satisfy, as MCC determines in its sole discretion, the condition that, If any of the Officers or key staff have been removed or resigned and the position remains vacant, MCA-Mongolia is actively engaged, to MCC's satisfaction, in recruiting a replacement.

As per Program Implementation Agreement (PIA) Section 3.5 (a) (i), MCA-Mongolia must deliver to MCC, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, a completed Disbursement Request, together with the Periodic Reports covering the related Disbursement Period.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
